# The set generated by 2x + 1, 3x + 1, 6x + 1 has density zero

It is not the case that the Klarner set has positive lower density ($\liminf_N |A \cap [0, N)|/N > 0$), where the Klarner set is the smallest set of natural numbers that contains $1$ and is closed under $x \mapsto 2x+1$, $x \mapsto 3x+1$ and $x \mapsto 6x+1$.

## Sources

- T. F. Bloom, Erdős Problems, Problem #1134, https://www.erdosproblems.com/1134.
- J. C. Lagarias, Erdős, Klarner, and the 3x + 1 problem, Amer. Math. Monthly 123 (2016), 753–776.
